top_signals.title: Stock Selloff Deepens on Tech Earnings, Bonds Rise: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Technology shares led a global stock selloff as another round of disappointing earnings accelerated a rotation out of the artificial intelligence trade and drove investors toward haven assets. Treasuries rallied.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
